messages.content: I’ll use the day-ahead market for the initial energy and reserve position, then revisit dispatch at every watch as weather and prices change. I’ll keep enough battery energy to back reserves and track the final 100 MWh requirement.

All three day-ahead gates are covered. The final dispatch plan sells about 100 MWh at 19:00 CPT, leaving 100 MWh to back the evening reserves and meet the end-of-window requirement. No reserve failures have settled so far.
